body.name: Orthogonal published OVS normal signal
body.construction:
For \(e=(u,c,c')\in\mathcal E_{\mathrm{OVS}}\), set
\[
g_e^{\mathrm{OVS}}(x)=d_{c,u}(x)-d_{c',u}(x).
\]
For a candidate nuisance \(\widetilde\eta=(\widetilde p,\widetilde m)\) with positive retained propensity coordinates, define \(Z_e^{\mathrm{OVS}}(O;\widetilde\eta)\) by replacing \((p,m)\) with \((\widetilde p,\widetilde m)\) in Definition \(\ref{def:ovs-normal-projection}\), and put
\[
S_e^{\mathrm{OVS}}(O;\widetilde\eta)
=\widetilde d_{c,u}(X)-\widetilde d_{c',u}(X)
+Z_e^{\mathrm{OVS}}(O;\widetilde\eta),
\qquad
\widetilde d_{a,u}=\widetilde m_{a,1,u}-\widetilde m_{a,0,u}.
\]
Stack the coordinates in \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{OVS}}\)-order as \(S^{\mathrm{OVS}}(O;\widetilde\eta)\), with the zero-dimensional convention.
